notes.title: Release 1.20
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335807/605d138bf3698299d53cf48a4a79ee074ebf2483.png[/img]

Release 1.20

- Min energy course added (gliding, wind lift)
- Gathering from eagles
- Optional ground assist mode for avoiding terrain and water
- Speed lock added for easier bird control
- Train improvement

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335807/1eac41004b1651126df4a9262edd85157566d8e6.png[/img]

notes.title: Japanese Interface
notes.content:
Greetings All,

I have added Japanese support for the UI. It was done using Google translate, so please be amused rather than offended at the translation mistakes. I have been influenced by some wonderful Anime artwork, so Japanese seemed appropriate.

notes.title: Release 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335807/40d7bdd778422b45b6f8123c9891e8152c02b1c5.png[/img]

Release 1.1

- Railway added to game for bird to fly through for gather challenge.
- Spot landing on branch challenge
- Slalom challenge
- Gather from trees added
- New Skies
- Tower track added

notes.title: Game Released
notes.content: Small Bird Forest is now available as an Early Access Game, thoughts appreciated.
